_why: Single source for the party game rentals line (owner-approved 2026-10-13). scripts/generators/build_rentals_page.js renders /rentals/ from this file; docs/listings/facebook-marketplace.md quotes the same rates. Images under assets/rentals/ are AI placeholders (Workers AI flux-1-schnell, free allowance) until real photos replace them.

games.name: Giant Connect Four
games.blurb: Four-in-a-row at yard scale. Big enough for kids and adults to play standing up.
games.alt: Black father and daughter dropping red and yellow discs into a four-foot giant connect four game at a Memphis backyard party

games.name: Cornhole Set
games.blurb: Two regulation boards and eight bags. Two sets available for a tournament.
games.alt: Black woman tossing a bean bag at a wooden cornhole board on a green lawn at a backyard party

games.name: Giant Tumble Tower
games.blurb: The giant block-stacking game. 54 wooden blocks that stack to about five feet before it falls.
games.alt: Two Black boys sliding a block from a giant wooden tumble tower on a backyard lawn at a party

games.name: Giant Yard Pong
games.blurb: Twelve buckets and balls for a lawn-sized pong game.
games.alt: Black adult friends tossing a ball toward white buckets set up for giant yard pong on a lawn

games.name: Ladder Toss
games.blurb: Two ladders and six bolas. Easy to learn, good for every age at the party.
games.alt: Black grandfather tossing a bola at a ladder toss frame while his grandchildren cheer on a backyard lawn

games.name: Giant Dice (Yardzee)
games.blurb: Oversized dice for Yardzee or any dice game. Score cards are easy to print at home.
games.alt: Black children rolling oversized dice on a green lawn at a backyard party

games.name: Giant Checkers
games.blurb: A four-by-four-foot mat with oversized pieces. Works on a lawn, a porch or indoors.
games.alt: Black mother and her young son kneeling on a giant checkers mat on a backyard lawn, moving oversized black checker pieces

games.name: Giant Tic-Tac-Toe
games.blurb: A three-foot wooden frame with big X and O pieces. The easiest game for the youngest guests.
games.alt: Black girl placing an X piece in a three-foot wooden tic-tac-toe frame on a lawn while her friend waits her turn

games.name: Giant Color Stack
games.blurb: A two-foot color-sorting stacking puzzle for ages 6 and up. Two available.
games.alt: Young Black children sorting colorful rings onto a giant color stack puzzle on a green lawn
